summary: Three storylines with the clash on the page, endings that read the pair's own feelings, and a Journal line for every flag; using canon pairs is the right call, since a queue carries one role. Two continuity fixes, both made.

issues.problem: The text states Corvin's last warning (a personal fact) whether or not the player knows it.
issues.fix: {knows(corvin.last_warning): … | If Bram finds it there, Corvin is finished.}

issues.problem: A sunny Sunday in the orchard with the bees can be pushed in winter, or with Tobias or Mir away; tm_invitation's 'Sunday, to see the bees' likewise.
issues.fix: defer: season == "winter" on both, and on tm_end also until both are around.
